claim_boundary: This is a deterministic computational development review of four new source-scoped representation cases plus nine inherited decisions, not a human Phase B submission or a selection freeze.

The implementing agent and informed source-challenge agent use the same model family; their errors may be correlated and agreement is not statistical independence, human review, or domain-expert review.

PASS and SCOPED_PASS mean that the named operation fits the generic probe contract using cited source assertions; they do not mean that a v3 record, balanced Rhea reaction, mechanism, tier, or structure applicability has been compiled.
ABSTAIN preserves source metadata while blocking the requested operation whose required clauses are absent.

Source mechanism states remain source proposals unless a primary-source evidence entry explicitly says otherwise; no missing chemistry, topology, carrier site, chain state, processivity, residue mapping, or reaction direction is inferred.

component_state.purpose: Represent source-identified components, their association mode, and only the component states or transitions the cited source asserts.

polymer_topology.purpose: Separate polymer identity from before/after topology, chain-length variables, initiation or elongation, and processivity.

tethered_carrier_reaction_instance.purpose: Separate catalyst identity, carrier-owner role, covalently tethered reactant/product states, attachment site, and structural localization.
